sections.text:
This document outlines the equipment inspection checklist I4, to be performed 
every five years as indicated by Y5 in the title block.
The generator data: 277MVA, 15.75KV, 10.173KA, PF=0.8, 50HZ, 3000 rpm, Y connection

The first draft initiated by eng. Abdel Aziz El Bagoury, 
tested by eng. Enas Azmy and revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Saad Bassuony, 
accepted by eng. Aly Abdel Wahab general director and approved by eng. Fathy 
Ragab head sector of Talkha PS.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.

A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment.
The unit must be out of service.

sections.text: Remove both rotor and stator of generator.

Before and after cleaning slip ring of rotor measure 
 the insulation resistance between slip ring and earth by using megger device 
 500Vdc approximately ≥ 3 MΩ, table 1.

Measure the deeps of slip ring according the reading in 
 table 2 will state for grading or not.

Clean the surface, guid of air and the winding of 
 rotor.
Check any cracks in rotor by using ultra sonic test.

Measure the ohmic resistance of the winding by using 
 battery 12V as in figure 1, compare with the standard value.

Check the bearing insulation by using megger device 
 500Vdc.
